scope: United States district-court civil case initiation and national-rule baseline

rules.diversity: 28 U.S.C. § 1332; complete diversity and amount in controversy exceeding $75,000, exclusive of interest and costs

required_initiating_documents: JS-44 civil cover sheet or district-approved equivalent
district-specific initiating documents and fee/IFP material

sources.description: Current national rules; Civil Rules last amended in 2025
Federal Rules of Civil Procedure in effect
Official CM/ECF filing, registration, PDF, and court-specific requirements

authority_boundary: National baseline only. District local rules, standing orders, judge practices, fees, admission, divisional venue, sealed-filing rules, and CM/ECF event selection must be verified immediately before filing.
